name: MediaFetch Pro Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: v1.8.0: True Quality & Format Engine: Full 4K/1440p/1080p/720p/480p/360p resolution fidelity without AV1 codec dropouts, exact container preservation for MOV, WEBM, MKV, MP4, WAV, M4A, FLAC, and MP3, enhanced Music Search format selection, and hardware-accelerated Adobe compatibility normalization.
New true Glassmorphism theme engine: Frosted, Clear, and Blur styles ported directly from MediaFetch Pro CEP plugin.
Optimized GPU compositing and zero nested blurs for extended battery life and smooth 60/120fps scrolling.
Short, clean theme selector (Amoled, Frosted, Clear, Blur) with high-contrast text legibility across all UI elements.
